messages.title: Deployment confirmed: WX-4090
messages.body: Overseer dh, deployment to Region WX-4090 is confirmed. Your team, temporary accommodation and supply allocation are present. Open your SeerPad personnel roster, review available supplies, and confirm access to Construction. Your first objective is to keep these categories populated.

messages.title: Private channel
messages.body: Private channel. Mara Venn, Outpost Coordination. CentroCom will give you the checklist. I'll point out the parts that can get somebody hurt. Start with food and a spare bed. The tents are real. The optimism came with the tablet.
